expect.note: every `specs/decisions/ADR-*.md` id appears exactly once in the reviewer page's `ADRS` digest, and every row is a 2-tuple of (id, one-liner).

provenance: PR #56 R2 (MEDIUM). M42 widened the digest with a blind `"026",` -> `"026", "027", "028",` substitution, producing a FOUR-element row against a `([n, line])` destructure: the page rendered "ADR-026 — 027", ADR-026's real one-liner was dropped, ADR-027/028/029 never reached a visitor, and `${ADRS.length}` undercounted. Nothing read `ADRS` — `grep -n ADRS src/browser/eval_adapter.py` returned zero — so a public page's summary of this repo's decisions was ungraded prose. The check also finds ADR-023 missing since M39, which is why it is a COVERAGE check and not a shape check: the malformed row is the visible half of the problem.
